Welcome to The Rehab, where skill meets purpose.

This channel is your go-to resource for mastering manual therapy, clinical rehab techniques, and functional movement training. Whether you're a physical therapist, massage therapist, athletic trainer, or student, you'll find real-world tools here to elevate your hands-on work and clinical reasoning.

🧠 Learn evidence-based techniques
💪 Improve manual therapy skills
🎥 Watch clear, practical demonstrations
🎯 Build confidence through a better understanding

New videos weekly. No fluff. Just straight-up education that helps you do the job better.

Subscribe and turn on notifications; your next breakthrough starts here.
You can find us on: 
https://www.facebook.com/therehabwellness 
https://www.instagram.com/therehabwellness/ 

#ManualTherapy #RehabEducation #Therapy #MassageTherapy #Bodywork #ContinuingEducation.
